Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM); Glioblastoma Multiforme, Adult

candidate_evidence.quote: Intervention is intended as a laboratory intervention and not as a clinical intervention.

PDOs and GSCs representing different GBM molecular subtypes will be treated with epigenetic modulators , with spliceosome inhibitors or with drugs that indirectly target the splicing machinery, such as PRMT5 inhibitors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histological resemblance of PDOs generated from primary and recurrent tumor will be rated semiquantitatively (0-10).

source_quote.quote: adult patients undergoing resective neurosurgery for glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype

coder_notes: Laboratory study (phase NA): patient tumour tissue is used to grow organoids/GSCs that are treated ex vivo with unnamed epigenetic modulators, splicing inhibitors and PRMT5 inhibitors. No drug is administered to patients, so no agents listed and S6 fails (no_pharmacological_candidate). IDH-wildtype is used only to define glioblastoma. Treatment setting unclear: no treatment given; tissue from surgery without prior chemo/RT, but primary and recurrent PDOs are mentioned. Ex vivo TE transcript and splice-variant profiling are not patient biomarkers and were not recorded.
